description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/SearchProduct/RecoverListings. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Recovers all hidden published products in the selected reconnected store. ownerAgent: listings. Domain: listings. Entity: recoverable_listing. Operation: recover_all. Scope: current_store. Use when: Use after the user explicitly confirms recovery of products returned in getMissingListings.RecoverableListings. Input: Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. No body or import options. Requires ownership of the linked store and user confirmation. Output: Returns RecoveredCount, the number of existing HGR products restored; repeated requests may return zero. Search terms: searchproduct recoverlistings. Requires confirmed=true before execution. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

name: hgr_post_searchproduct_recoverlistings
title: Post Searchproduct Recoverlistings
